words.definition: to highlight or give more importance to something
words.example: The colorful dress accentuated the joy of the occasion.

words.definition: to brainstorm: to come up with an idea
words.zh: 集思廣益：想出一個主意

words.definition: to hide the usual appearance of something
words.example: It is hard to disguise the fact that business is slow.
The archaeologist found a rare fossil embedded in the rock face.

words.definition: to set on fire; to give energy or life to something
words.example: The jury's decision ignited a fierce debate in the legal community.
words.zh: 放火；賦予某物能量或生命

words.definition: being uninterested or not caring about something
words.example: The teacher was indifferent to student requests to extend the project's deadline.
words.zh: 對某事不感興趣或不關心

words.definition: to begin; to establish; to take decisive action without help
words.example: The newcomers initiated the long citizenship process.
words.zh: 開始；建立；在沒有幫助的情況下採取果斷行動

words.example: This innovative project is worthy of support.
words.zh: 新推出的東西；有創意的

words.example: The American actor, Morgan Freeman, narrated the documentary film.
The trail was steep and wet; nevertheless, the hikers reached the research station safely.

words.definition: being old fashioned; no longer in general use
words.example: Some people believe that writing instruments, such as pencils and pens, will soon be obsolete.
She inadvertently omitted some important data from the report.

words.definition: strange and unpleasant; beyond accepted norms
words.example: His outlandish ideas demonstrated his creativity.
words.zh: 奇怪和不愉快的；超出公認標準

words.definition: to defeat; fight with success; to take control of an individual
words.example: The young woman was overcome with emotion when she learned she had won a scholarship.
words.zh: 擊敗；爭取成功；控制一個人

words.definition: a part of the whole; incomplete
words.example: The clerk was only partially responsible for the error.
words.zh: 整體的一部分；不完整的

words.example: The actress portrayed an orphan in the movie.

words.definition: to update; to make more efficient or concise
words.example: The planning process must be streamlined in order for it to be more reliable.
words.zh: 更新；使更有效或更簡潔
